SUPER_ADMIN.label: Super Admin
SUPER_ADMIN.description: Full, locked access to every module, role and setting. Can grant the Super Admin role.

ADMIN.label: Administrator
ADMIN.description: Manages users, customers, items, zones and rules. Monitors every order live.

SALESMAN.label: Sales Executive
SALESMAN.description: Captures orders from calls, email and WhatsApp and submits them for approval.

SALES_MANAGER.label: Sales Manager
SALES_MANAGER.description: Approves value, quantity and credit limit — accepts, rejects or returns with a reason.

CUSTOMER_SERVICE.label: Customer Service
CUSTOMER_SERVICE.description: Consolidates approved orders per salesman and releases them to dispatch.

DISPATCHER.label: Dispatcher
DISPATCHER.description: Places orders in delivery zones and assigns them to drivers.

DRIVER.label: Driver
DRIVER.description: Sees next-day deliveries, follows the route and confirms handover with OTP.

FINANCE.label: Finance Executive
FINANCE.description: Notified of approved orders and credit-limit exceptions. Issues prototype invoices and manages invoice templates.

WAREHOUSE_MANAGER.label: Warehouse Manager
WAREHOUSE_MANAGER.description: Runs receiving, stock, transfers and picking readiness across hubs; raises replenishment.

INVENTORY_EXECUTIVE.label: Inventory Executive
INVENTORY_EXECUTIVE.description: Records goods receipts and transfers and keeps stock levels accurate.

QA_MANAGER.label: QA Manager
QA_MANAGER.description: Reviews documents, quarantines damaged stock and watches expiry and cold-chain alerts.

CUSTOMER.label: Customer (Portal)
CUSTOMER.description: Read-only view of one customer account’s orders, deliveries and invoices.

SUPPLIER.label: Supplier (Portal)
SUPPLIER.description: Read-only view of approved replenishment addressed to one supplier.
